source_text: \subsection{{The abstract Hodge Laplacian}}\label{sec:abstract-hodge-laplacian}
translated_text: \subsection{{抽象 Hodge Laplacian}}\label{sec:abstract-hodge-laplacian}

source_text: {The harmonic forms also determine a necessary condition for the existence of solutions. Taking the inner product of the equation $L^k u=f$ with $q\in\mathsf H^k$ and using \eqref{eq:hodge-green-identity}, we see that $\langle f,q\rangle=0$. Thus a necessary condition for the existence of a solution is the orthogonality condition $f\perp\mathsf H^k$. In fact, in Theorem~\ref{thm:hodge-well-posedness} below we shall show that this condition is not only necessary but also sufficient for existence of a solution.}
translated_text: {调和形式还决定了解存在的一个必要条件. 将方程 $L^k u=f$ 与 $q\in\mathsf H^k$ 作内积, 并利用 \eqref{eq:hodge-green-identity}, 得 $\langle f,q\rangle=0$. 因此, 解存在的一个必要条件是正交条件 $f\perp\mathsf H^k$. 事实上, 下面的 Theorem~\ref{thm:hodge-well-posedness} 将证明这一条件不仅必要, 而且足以保证解的存在.}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Three formulations of the Hodge Laplace problem}}\label{subsec:hodge-three-formulations}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{Hodge Laplace 问题的三种表述}}\label{subsec:hodge-three-formulations}

source_text: {In order to formulate a problem which is solvable for any $f\in W^k$, we make use of the orthogonal projection $P_{\mathsf H}$ of $W^k$ onto $\mathsf H^k$. Then we can formulate the following \emph{strong form} of the Hodge Laplace equation, which we shall show is well-posed.}
translated_text: {为了构造对任意 $f\in W^k$ 都可解的问题, 利用 $W^k$ 到 $\mathsf H^k$ 上的正交投影 $P_{\mathsf H}$. 由此可提出 Hodge Laplace 方程的如下\emph{强表述}, 我们将证明它是适定的.}

source_text: {We will also consider two weak formulations of this problem. The primal formulation corresponds directly to the strong form.}
translated_text: {还将考虑该问题的两种弱表述. 原始表述直接对应于强表述.}

source_text: {For the mixed weak formulation, we introduce two new variables, $\sigma=d^*u\in V^{k-1}$ and $p=P_{\mathsf H}f\in\mathsf H^k$.}
translated_text: {对混合弱表述, 引入两个新变量 $\sigma=d^*u\in V^{k-1}$ 和 $p=P_{\mathsf H}f\in\mathsf H^k$.}

source_text: {An important observation is that the mixed weak formulation, unlike the other two formulations, does not treat the operators $d$ and $d^*$ symmetrically. Only the $d$ operator appears in this formulation, the terms involving $d^*$ being treated weakly.}
translated_text: {一个重要观察是, 与另两种表述不同, 混合弱表述并不对称地处理算子 $d$ 与 $d^*$. 这种表述中只出现算子 $d$, 涉及 $d^*$ 的项以弱形式处理.}

source_text: {Despite their different appearance, the three formulations are completely equivalent.}
translated_text: {尽管形式不同, 这三种表述完全等价.}

source_text:
{Finally, if $(\sigma,u,p)\in V\times V\times\mathsf H$ solves the mixed weak formulation, then the first equation implies $u\in V^*$ and $d^*u=\sigma$, and the last equation implies that $u\perp\mathsf H$. Taking $v\in\mathsf H$ in the second equation shows that $p=P_{\mathsf H}f$. Finally, taking $v\in V\cap V^*$ in the second equation we conclude that $u$ solves the primal weak formulation.}
\end{Proof}
translated_text:
{最后, 若 $(\sigma,u,p)\in V\times V\times\mathsf H$ 是混合弱表述的解, 则第一个方程给出 $u\in V^*$ 和 $d^*u=\sigma$, 最后一个方程给出 $u\perp\mathsf H$. 在第二个方程中取 $v\in\mathsf H$, 可知 $p=P_{\mathsf H}f$. 最后, 在第二个方程中取 $v\in V\cap V^*$, 可得 $u$ 是原始弱表述的解.}
\end{Proof}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Well-posedness}}\label{subsec:hodge-well-posedness}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{适定性}}\label{subsec:hodge-well-posedness}

source_text: {Finally, we show that the abstract Hodge Laplace equation is well-posed once we account for any harmonic forms.}
translated_text: {最后证明, 在计入调和形式之后, 抽象 Hodge Laplace 方程是适定的.}

source_text:
{Having established well-posedness of the Hodge Laplacian, we denote by $K$ the solution operator. That is, for $f\in W$, we define $Kf\in D(L)$ by the equations $LKf=f-P_{\mathsf H}f$, $Kf\perp\mathsf H$. Written in terms of $K$, the solution to the mixed formulation is given by $\sigma=d^*Kf$, $u=Kf$, $p=P_{\mathsf H}f$. Thus the Hodge projections are $P_{\mathcal B}=dd^*K$, $P_{\mathcal B^*}=d^*dK$, and}
\[
u=dd^*Ku+P_{\mathsf H}u+d^*dKu,\qquad u\in W.
\]
translated_text:
{已确立 Hodge Laplacian 的适定性, 将解算子记为 $K$. 即对 $f\in W$, 通过方程 $LKf=f-P_{\mathsf H}f$, $Kf\perp\mathsf H$ 定义 $Kf\in D(L)$. 用 $K$ 表示, 混合表述的解由 $\sigma=d^*Kf$, $u=Kf$, $p=P_{\mathsf H}f$ 给出. 因而 Hodge 投影为 $P_{\mathcal B}=dd^*K$, $P_{\mathcal B^*}=d^*dK$, 且}
\[
u=dd^*Ku+P_{\mathsf H}u+d^*dKu,\qquad u\in W.
\]

source_text: \subsubsection{{The $\mathcal B$ and $\mathcal B^*$ problems}}\label{subsec:boundary-coboundary-problems}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{$\mathcal B$ 与 $\mathcal B^*$ 问题}}\label{subsec:boundary-coboundary-problems}

source_text: {This formal calculation is justified as long as $v=du\in D(L)$. To see this, note that, since $u\in D(L)$, $v=du\in V^*$ and $v\in V$. Moreover $dv=0$ and $d^*v=d^*du=P_{\mathcal B^*}f=f-P_{\mathcal Z}f\in V$, since $f\in V$ and $\mathcal Z\subset V$. This shows that $v\in D(L)$, as claimed.}
translated_text: {只要 $v=du\in D(L)$, 这一形式计算就有依据. 为说明这一点, 注意由于 $u\in D(L)$, 有 $v=du\in V^*$ 且 $v\in V$. 此外 $dv=0$, 并且由 $f\in V$ 及 $\mathcal Z\subset V$, 有 $d^*v=d^*du=P_{\mathcal B^*}f=f-P_{\mathcal Z}f\in V$. 这就表明 $v\in D(L)$, 如前所述.}

source_text: {Thus, when the data $g$ for the Hodge Laplacian belongs to $\mathcal B$, the corresponding solution $v$ also belongs to $\mathcal B$. But then the term $d^*dv$ in the Hodge Laplacian vanishes, so $v$ satisfies another problem.}
translated_text: {因此, 当 Hodge Laplacian 的数据 $g$ 属于 $\mathcal B$ 时, 相应解 $v$ 也属于 $\mathcal B$. 此时 Hodge Laplacian 中的项 $d^*dv$ 为零, 所以 $v$ 满足另一个问题.}

source_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{The $\mathcal B$ problem}}\par
{Given $g\in\mathcal B^k$, find $v\in\mathcal B^k$ such that $dd^*v=g$.}
translated_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{$\mathcal B$ 问题}}\par
{给定 $g\in\mathcal B^k$, 求 $v\in\mathcal B^k$, 使 $dd^*v=g$.}

source_text: {By definition, a solution to this problem must belong as well to $D(dd^*)=\{\,v\in V_k^*\mid d^*v\in V^{k-1}\,\}$. We have just seen that, for $g\in\mathcal B^k$, if $v$ solves the Hodge Laplace problem with data $g$, then $v$ solves the $\mathcal B$ problem. Conversely, if $v$ solves the $\mathcal B$ problem, then we have $dv=0$, and so $Lv=dd^*v=g$, i.e., $v$ solves the Hodge Laplace problem. From the well-posedness of the Hodge Laplace problem, we obtain well-posedness of the $\mathcal B$ problem (but only for $g\in\mathcal B^k$; otherwise there is no solution).}
translated_text: {按定义, 此问题的解还必须属于 $D(dd^*)=\{\,v\in V_k^*\mid d^*v\in V^{k-1}\,\}$. 刚才已看到, 对 $g\in\mathcal B^k$, 若 $v$ 是数据为 $g$ 的 Hodge Laplace 问题的解, 则 $v$ 是 $\mathcal B$ 问题的解. 反之, 若 $v$ 是 $\mathcal B$ 问题的解, 则有 $dv=0$, 从而 $Lv=dd^*v=g$, 即 $v$ 是 Hodge Laplace 问题的解. 由 Hodge Laplace 问题的适定性, 得到 $\mathcal B$ 问题的适定性 (但仅对 $g\in\mathcal B^k$; 否则无解).}

source_text: {Of course, we have the analogous result for $d^*$ as well: if $f\in V^*$ and $u$ the corresponding solution to the Hodge Laplace problem, then $v=d^*u\in D(L)$ and is the solution to the Hodge Laplace problem with data $g=d^*f$. Moreover, if $g\in\mathcal B^*$, then it is also the unique solution to the following problem.}
translated_text: {当然, 对 $d^*$ 也有类似结论: 若 $f\in V^*$, 且 $u$ 为相应 Hodge Laplace 问题的解, 则 $v=d^*u\in D(L)$, 并且它是数据为 $g=d^*f$ 的 Hodge Laplace 问题的解. 此外, 若 $g\in\mathcal B^*$, 则它也是下述问题的唯一解.}

source_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{The $\mathcal B^*$ problem}}\par
{Given $g\in\mathcal B_k^*$, find $v\in\mathcal B_k^*$ such that $d^*dv=g$.}
translated_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{$\mathcal B^*$ 问题}}\par
{给定 $g\in\mathcal B_k^*$, 求 $v\in\mathcal B_k^*$, 使 $d^*dv=g$.}
